person.summary: Fu-Yuan Cheng (gloomcheng) is an entrepreneur, software architect, and educator. He is currently a Ph.D. candidate at the Graduate School of Engineering Science and Technology, National Yunlin University of Science and Technology (NYUST). He serves as Founder & CEO of WeeMed AI, Founder & CEO of FANSEE Co., Ltd., and Founder & CTO of ZhèLâng Co., Ltd. His work focuses on healthcare information standards (SMART on FHIR), augmented reality (AR) interactive education, and the open-source community.

items.detail: FHIR-first healthcare Vertical AI platform (Hygieia), returning clinical focus to patient care. Encompasses clinical decision support, Breeze-ASR-26 medical speech recognition models, SMART on FHIR interoperability pipelines, and operational systems (Hi-Checkup, Hi-Care, Hi-Work, Hi-Hope, Hi-Mate) deployed across regional hospital networks (Kaohsiung Medical University health system) and community clinics.

Interactive AR educational toys, digital theater boxes, and creative storytelling platforms. Creator of the 'Picture & Fairytale' AR theater box (recognized by Taiwan's national Golden Tripod Awards) with folklore and indigenous language editions; partnered with libraries and enterprises for cultural-tech interactive exhibitions.

Digital production house founded on the open-source ethos of 'all for one, one for all' (ZhèLâng). Engineered custom web platforms, cloud architecture, and enterprise software. Originated the online health management scheduling system with Kaohsiung Municipal Tatung Hospital that laid the technical foundation for subsequent healthcare automation.
